name: canvas-generative
title_zh: 粒子、流场、分形、L系统，一个画布全给你
tagline_zh: 想玩生成艺术却不想碰 WebGL？Canvas 2D 就能跑粒子、噪声、分形和 L-system。
tagline_en: Generative art without WebGL? Particles, noise, fractals & L-systems on Canvas 2D. Tweak params and render—no.
desc_en: Algorithmic and generative art with Canvas 2D - particles, flow fields, noise, fractals, L-systems.
why_zh: 把算法生成从 shader 门槛里捞出来，用 Canvas 2D 的像素级控制做粒子与流场。
why_en: Pulls generative art off the shader pedestal—Canvas 2D gives pixel-level control for particles & flow fields, with instant.
limit_zh: 只出 Canvas 2D 静态帧或逐帧动画，不导出 SVG/PDF/视频。
limit_en: Outputs Canvas 2D frames or frame-by-frame animation only—no SVG/PDF/video export. Requires basic JS & Canvas API knowledge; code-only, no GUI.
title_en: Particles, flow fields, fractals & L-systems on one canvas
